name: Lair

components.pose: The dragon lies coiled across its hoard like a sleeping king, one wing half-spread, head raised and turned toward the camera with a proud, watchful gaze, smoke curling from its nostrils.
components.background: a vast volcanic cavern of black basalt with rivers of glowing lava and rising heat shimmer, a shaft of ember-orange light from a distant vent
components.hoard: heaps of gold coins and molten-edged ingots, forged swords and cracked shields, ember-glowing crystals, scorched obsidian and half-melted golden statues
components.effects: A few drifting embers and a soft heat shimmer rise from the hoard - understated, nothing busy.

denoise: n/a — full text-to-image, no incoming reference
notes: Daily-post lair shot: the dragon at rest on the kind of hoard its element would collect.
